sources.lesson: A truthy release argument removes a client instead of pooling it.
Discard uncertain transaction-control sessions via release(true).
All transaction queries must use one connection.
Use fresh meaningful failure evidence rather than marking gates complete from source documentation.
MPS health/purchase GET connectivity is separate from native-token purchase/withdrawal implementation.

limitations: Mock transport control-failure tests and serialized PGlite SQL/RLS are not hosted PostgreSQL crash/concurrency proof.
No credentials, external payment request, signer, closing transaction or deployment was used.
Current official GitHub master is pinned for research only; no dependency upgrade or copied upstream code.
